title: Step 3: REVIEWS corpus in unified_corpus.py and reviews loader in rubric_screen.py
description:
## Purpose

Step 3: `REVIEWS` corpus in `unified_corpus.py` and a reviews loader in `scripts/rubric_screen.py`.

## Scope

- Labels (precedence order abusive > promotional > seller_shipping > price_availability > approve; merge abusive into "remove_other" if < 20 pool cases), S one-liner, F path (under `var/`), ceiling, `final_size=300`, multiclass metrics.
- Splits: SME labels 1,500; stream 600 + held-out 300 drawn stratified by SME label (each minority class >= ~10%); natural-mix random 300 reported too. Disjoint partitions; nothing tuned on held-out.
- Reviews loader in `scripts/rubric_screen.py` for the Stage 0 S-vs-F screen.

## Definition of done

Specs pass offline with fixtures; `make test` and `make unified-flywheel-test` green; existing corpora replays byte-identical.

## Caps

$0 (offline).

comments.text: Done in 4233620 (local, not pushed). unified_reviews.py + spec (15 specs, offline, synthetic pool/cache + fake SME); corpora 'reviews' and 'reviews-merged' registered in unified_corpus.py (labels approve, abusive, promotional, seller_shipping, price_availability; S = studies/amazon_reviews/S.txt; F = var/policy/amazon_reviews_F.txt read only for ceiling/stakeholder; final_size 300; multiclass). Merge abusive+promotional -> remove_other decided from data (abusive < 20 SME-labeled); each corpus refuses the other's data. Splits: held-out 300 + stream 600 stratified by SME label (>=10% per class where available, 1:2 cut), dev-100 from the rest, seed reviews-splits-v1; ambiguous/rejected/unlabeled excluded and counted; natural-mix SME labels reported separately. SME cache read via mode=ro (live cache never written). rubric_screen: --datasets reviews --split heldout --conditions S,F (+ --dry-run); scripts/reviews_splits.py prints the report. Not run on real data (SME run in progress). Screen = 600 Jev requests upper bound; max request ~1,500 tokens (F 1,387 + review <=117, words x1.3). make test 534 passed/11 skipped; unified-flywheel-test 319 passed; phase2-live-seed1 copies replayed (rounds and --final): predictions.jsonl and final-predictions.jsonl byte-identical, 0 requests.
